title: Two-Tailed Rat
move_pattern: Randomly cycles between Scratch, Disease Bite, and Screech. Occasionally attempts to use Call for Backup to summon allies (up to 3 times per combat, with a 2-turn cooldown between summons).
notes: Summon mechanics: Two-Tailed Rats track a global summon counter across all rats in combat. Call for Backup is limited to 3 total summons per encounter and requires a 2-turn cooldown (decremented by each move). When unable to summon, the rat focuses on attacking.
